Market today: The mood is sour for tech, especially chips and data centers. Voters pushing back on data centers and weak earnings forecasts from Qualcomm are the real drivers, directly hitting your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SMH (-20.76%), SMCI (-32.54%), MUU (-48.29%), and SOXL (-70.33%) are flashing deep red and "SELL" status. These leveraged positions amplify drops, and with margin, drawdowns hurt extra.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further news regarding data center infrastructure and broader chip sector sentiment. The election results are clearly impacting this space.

Bottom line: This is a critical time to manage risk in your deeply underwater tech/chip positions, especially the leveraged ones.
plays: Respect the stop on SMH at 540; current price 504.27, already -20.76%.
Consider trimming SOXL (current -70.33%) and MUU (current -48.29%) due to their leveraged nature and the negative chip sector news.
No new buys today; the market signals for your sector are too negative to initiate new long positions.
